title: Immobilizer — information
body: Jeep / Stellantis immobilizer behavior varies by platform and security gateway policy. This tier surfaces reference notes only: it does not add keys, program transponders, or bypass security.
footnote: No key programming. Use OEM-approved security procedures for keys and modules.

skreemModule.role: SKIM validates transponder keys; SKREEM integrates remote-entry and immobilizer policy with the PCM. Loss of all keys or module replacement requires dealer-level PIN and authorized tooling.
skreemModule.tier3Scope: Info-only: module names, risk context, and catalog path programming/immobilizer/skim_key_learn — no PIN capture or automated key learn in this app.
